name: Seth Green NFTs
rootCause: On May 8, 2022, Seth Green lost four major NFTs, including Bored Ape #8398, to a wallet phishing attack on Ethereum. The stolen assets were transferred and resold, then the main NFT was recovered after negotiating a 165 ETH payment to its buyer. Green connected his wallet to a phishing site impersonating a legitimate NFT mint. This social engineering attack induced him to sign blockchain transactions, directly transferring four valuable NFTs to the attacker's address. There were no further smart contract bugs.
